LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT OF DERMOT ALOYSIUS HALLORAN

I, Dermot Aloysius Halloran, a resident of and domiciled in Franklin County, Ohio, being of sound mind and memory and not acting under duress, menace, fraud, or the undue influence of any person, declare this to be my Last Will and Testament, and I revoke all wills and codicils previously made by me.

ARTICLE I — FAMILY

I am married to Priya Raghunathan Halloran. I have three children now living: Ana Halloran, Emil Halloran, and Soren Halloran. Any reference in this Will to my children includes any child born to or adopted by me after the execution of this Will.

ARTICLE II — DEBTS, EXPENSES, AND TAXES

I direct my Executor to pay from my residuary estate the expenses of my last illness and funeral, the costs of administering my estate, and all estate, inheritance, and succession taxes payable by reason of my death, without apportionment and without reimbursement from any beneficiary or from the recipient of any non-probate asset.

ARTICLE III — SPECIFIC BEQUESTS

I give my grandfather's pocket watch to my son Emil Halloran, if he survives me by thirty (30) days. I give the sum of Fifty Thousand Dollars ($50,000) to Ridgeline Community Hospital Foundation, an Ohio nonprofit corporation, for its general charitable purposes. If any beneficiary of a specific bequest does not survive me by thirty (30) days, that bequest lapses and becomes part of my residuary estate.

ARTICLE IV — RESIDUARY ESTATE

I give the residue of my estate, real and personal, wherever situated, to my wife Priya Raghunathan Halloran if she survives me by thirty (30) days. If she does not, I give the residue to my children who survive me by thirty (30) days, in equal shares, per stirpes, provided that the share of any child who has not then reached the age of thirty (30) shall be held in trust under Article V.

ARTICLE V — TRUST FOR A YOUNG BENEFICIARY

Any share directed to be held in trust under Article IV shall be held by my Trustee on the following terms. The Trustee may distribute so much of the income and principal as the Trustee determines advisable for the beneficiary's health, education, maintenance, and support. When the beneficiary reaches age thirty (30), the Trustee shall distribute the remaining trust property to the beneficiary outright. No interest of any beneficiary in income or principal shall be subject to voluntary or involuntary alienation, assignment, or the claims of that beneficiary's creditors before actual distribution.

ARTICLE VI — FIDUCIARIES

I appoint my wife Priya Raghunathan Halloran as Executor of this Will. If she is unable or unwilling to serve, I appoint my daughter Ana Halloran as successor Executor. I appoint Buckeye Fifth Bank, N.A. as Trustee of any trust created under this Will. No fiduciary serving under this Will shall be required to post bond in any jurisdiction.

ARTICLE VII — FIDUCIARY POWERS

My Executor and Trustee shall have all powers conferred by Ohio Revised Code Chapter 5808 and, in addition, the power to sell, lease, or exchange any property at public or private sale; to retain property received without regard to diversification; to invest and reinvest; to borrow and to pledge property as security; to make distributions in cash or in kind; and to employ and compensate attorneys, accountants, and investment advisers.

ARTICLE VIII — GUARDIAN

If my wife does not survive me and any child of mine is then a minor, I appoint my brother Cormac Halloran as guardian of the person and of the estate of that minor child, to serve without bond.

ARTICLE IX — NO-CONTEST

If any beneficiary contests this Will or any of its provisions, or assists another in doing so, without probable cause, that beneficiary shall forfeit any interest given under this Will and shall be treated as having predeceased me without surviving issue.

ARTICLE X — SIMULTANEOUS DEATH

If my wife and I die under circumstances in which the order of our deaths cannot be established, my wife shall be deemed to have predeceased me.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have signed this Will, consisting of four pages including this page, on the 14th day of September, 2026, at Columbus, Ohio.

/s/ Dermot Aloysius Halloran
Dermot Aloysius Halloran, Testator

ATTESTATION

The foregoing instrument was signed, published, and declared by Dermot Aloysius Halloran to be his Last Will and Testament in our presence, and we, at his request and in his presence and in the presence of each other, have subscribed our names as witnesses on the date last above written. Each of us is of legal age and competent to be a witness, and to the best of our knowledge the testator is of sound mind and under no constraint or undue influence.

/s/ Marisol Aguirre
Marisol Aguirre, residing at 41 Vinewood Lane, Columbus, Ohio

/s/ Yusuf Adeyemi
Yusuf Adeyemi, residing at 907 Kingsbury Road, Columbus, Ohio

SELF-PROVING AFFIDAVIT

State of Ohio, County of Franklin, ss:

We, Dermot Aloysius Halloran, Marisol Aguirre, and Yusuf Adeyemi, the testator and the witnesses respectively whose names are signed to the foregoing instrument, being first duly sworn, do hereby declare to the undersigned authority that the testator signed and executed the instrument as his Last Will and Testament, that he signed willingly, that he executed it as his free and voluntary act, and that each of the witnesses, in the presence and hearing of the testator, signed the Will as witness and that to the best of his or her knowledge the testator was at that time eighteen years of age or older, of sound mind, and under no constraint or undue influence.

Subscribed, sworn to, and acknowledged before me by the testator, and subscribed and sworn to before me by the witnesses, this 14th day of September, 2026.

/s/ Beatriz Sandoval
Notary Public, State of Ohio
